# Benchmark

This benchmark validates and times DuckHTS `bcftools_score()` and the test-only
query in `test/sql/score_reference.sql` against the
`bcftools +score` plugin bundled by
[`RGenomicsETL/RBCFTools`](https://github.com/RGenomicsETL/RBCFTools).
It covers both a single TSV/PLINK summary and multi-PRS TSV scoring where
several summary files are scored in one genotype scan. Because upstream
`bcftools +score` writes scores with `%#.6g`, the comparison formats DuckHTS
native scores the same way before checking cell-level equality. SQL sums float32
products in double precision. Its comparison uses the forward error bound
`(gamma(n, 2^-24) + gamma(n, 2^-53)) * A / (1-gamma(n, 2^-53))`, where
`A` is SQL `sum(abs(term))`, `gamma(n, u) = n*u/(1-n*u)` and `n` is the number
of contributing markers. The denominator accounts for rounding in `A`; using
`n` rather than `n-1` leaves slack for evaluating the bound.
This assumes finite normal arithmetic and `n*2^-24 < 1`. Counts must match exactly.
All engines read the same BGZF VCF and TSV summaries, with counts enabled.
Parity is checked before any timed repeat. DuckDB uses one thread, a 4 GB memory
limit and a 3 GB spill limit; upstream uses one thread.

# Run

`make bench-score`

Useful overrides:

- `SCORE_BENCH_ROWS`: synthetic VCF variants, default `500000`
- `SCORE_BENCH_SAMPLES`: genotype samples, default `100`
- `SCORE_BENCH_PRS`: TSV summary files for the multi-PRS case, default `4`
- `SCORE_BENCH_RUNS`: timed repeats, default `3`
- `BCFTOOLS_BIN`: optional override for the bcftools executable
- `SCORE_PLUGIN_DIR`: optional override for the bcftools plugin directory

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

if (!requireNamespace("RBCFTools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("RBCFTools is required for bcftools +score benchmarking", call. = FALSE)
}

RBCFTools::setup_hts_env()

bcftools_bin <- Sys.getenv("BCFTOOLS_BIN", unset = RBCFTools::bcftools_path())
score_plugin_dir <- Sys.getenv("SCORE_PLUGIN_DIR", unset = RBCFTools::bcftools_plugins_dir())
if (!file.exists(bcftools_bin)) stop("bcftools binary not found: ", bcftools_bin, call. = FALSE)
if (!file.exists(file.path(score_plugin_dir, "score.so"))) {
  stop("bcftools score plugin not found under: ", score_plugin_dir, call. = FALSE)
}

Sys.setenv(BCFTOOLS_PLUGINS = score_plugin_dir)

bench_rows <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SCORE_BENCH_ROWS", unset = "500000"))
bench_runs <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SCORE_BENCH_RUNS", unset = "3"))
n_samples <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SCORE_BENCH_SAMPLES", unset = "100"))
n_prs <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SCORE_BENCH_PRS", unset = "4"))

if (is.na(bench_rows) || bench_rows < 1L) stop("SCORE_BENCH_ROWS must be positive")
if (is.na(bench_runs) || bench_runs < 1L) stop("SCORE_BENCH_RUNS must be positive")
if (is.na(n_samples) || n_samples < 1L) stop("SCORE_BENCH_SAMPLES must be positive")
if (is.na(n_prs) || n_prs < 1L) stop("SCORE_BENCH_PRS must be positive")

drv <- duckdb::duckdb(config = list(allow_unsigned_extensions = "true"))
con <- dbConnect(drv, dbdir = ":memory:")

ext_path <- normalizePath("build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension", mustWork = TRUE)
DBI::dbExecute(con, sprintf("LOAD '%s';", gsub("\\\\", "/", ext_path)))
DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4;")
DBI::dbExecute(con, "SET memory_limit='4GB'")
DBI::dbExecute(con, "SET max_temp_directory_size='3GB'")
spill_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "score-spill")
dir.create(spill_dir)
DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("SET temp_directory = '", gsub("'", "''", spill_dir, fixed = TRUE), "'"))
score_reference <- paste(readLines("test/sql/score_reference.sql"), collapse = "\n")
```

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
shell_quote <- function(x) shQuote(x, type = "sh")

sql_string <- function(x) {
  sprintf("'%s'", gsub("'", "''", x, fixed = TRUE))
}

sql_summary_arg <- function(paths) {
  if (length(paths) == 1L) {
    sql_string(paths)
  } else {
    sprintf("[%s]", paste(sql_string(paths), collapse = ", "))
  }
}

run_cmd <- function(cmd) {
  status <- system(cmd, ignore.stdout = FALSE, ignore.stderr = FALSE)
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) stop("command failed: ", cmd, call. = FALSE)
}

write_score_fixture <- function(dir_path, n_variants, n_samples, n_prs) {
  dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  vcf_path <- file.path(dir_path, "score_input.vcf")
  vcf_gz <- paste0(vcf_path, ".gz")
  summary_paths <- file.path(dir_path, sprintf("score_summary_%02d.tsv", seq_len(n_prs)))

  sample_names <- sprintf("SAMPLE_%04d", seq_len(n_samples))
  header_lines <- c(
    "##fileformat=VCFv4.2",
    "##contig=<ID=1,length=250000000>",
    "##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description=\"Genotype\">",
    paste0("#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\t",
           paste(sample_names, collapse = "\t"))
  )

  alleles <- list(c("A", "T"), c("G", "C"), c("C", "A"), c("T", "G"))

  write_chunked <- function(path, header, n, make_line, chunk_size = 50000L) {
    con_out <- file(path, open = "wt")
    on.exit(close(con_out), add = TRUE)
    writeLines(header, con_out)
    for (start in seq.int(1L, n, by = chunk_size)) {
      end <- min(n, start + chunk_size - 1L)
      idx <- seq.int(start, end)
      writeLines(vapply(idx, make_line, character(1)), con_out)
    }
  }

  write_chunked(vcf_path, header_lines, n_variants, function(i) {
    al <- alleles[[(i - 1L) %% length(alleles) + 1L]]
    pos <- i * 10L
    rsid <- sprintf("rs%d", i)
    gts <- sample(c("0/0", "0/1", "1/1"), n_samples, replace = TRUE,
                  prob = c(0.5, 0.35, 0.15))
    paste0("1\t", pos, "\t", rsid, "\t", al[1], "\t", al[2],
           "\t.\tPASS\t.\tGT\t", paste(gts, collapse = "\t"))
  })

  for (prs_i in seq_len(n_prs)) {
    set.seed(1000L + prs_i)
    write_chunked(summary_paths[[prs_i]], "CHR\tBP\tSNP\tA1\tBETA\tP", n_variants, function(i) {
      al <- alleles[[(i - 1L) %% length(alleles) + 1L]]
      pos <- i * 10L
      rsid <- sprintf("rs%d", i)
      beta <- round(rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = 0.5), 4)
      p <- runif(1, 1e-8, 1)
      paste0("1\t", pos, "\t", rsid, "\t", al[2], "\t", beta, "\t", p)
    })
  }

  run_cmd(sprintf(
    "%s view -Oz -o %s %s",
    shell_quote(bcftools_bin), shell_quote(vcf_gz), shell_quote(vcf_path)
  ))
  run_cmd(sprintf("%s index -t %s", shell_quote(bcftools_bin), shell_quote(vcf_gz)))

  list(
    vcf_path = vcf_path,
    vcf_gz = vcf_gz,
    summary_paths = summary_paths,
    n_variants = n_variants,
    n_samples = n_samples,
    n_prs = n_prs
  )
}

duckdb_score_sql <- function(vcf_path, summary_paths) {
  paste0(
    "SELECT * FROM bcftools_score(",
    sql_string(vcf_path), ", ",
    sql_summary_arg(summary_paths), ", ",
    "use := 'GT', columns := 'PLINK', counts := true) ",
    "ORDER BY SAMPLE"
  )
}

set_sql_inputs <- function(vcf_path, summary_paths, bounds = FALSE) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("SET VARIABLE score_path = ", sql_string(vcf_path)))
  DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("SET VARIABLE score_summaries = [",
                            paste(sql_string(summary_paths), collapse = ", "), "]"))
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "SET VARIABLE score_use = 'GT'")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "SET VARIABLE score_counts = true")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("SET VARIABLE score_bounds = ", if (bounds) "true" else "false"))
}

run_duckdb_bench <- function(vcf_path, summary_paths, n = 3L, engine = "duckhts_native") {
  if (engine == "duckhts_sql") set_sql_inputs(vcf_path, summary_paths)
  sql <- if (engine == "duckhts_sql") score_reference else duckdb_score_sql(vcf_path, summary_paths)
  times <- numeric(n)
  output_samples <- NA_integer_
  score_columns <- NA_integer_
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=1")
  on.exit(DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4"), add = TRUE)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    gc()
    t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    out <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sql)
    times[i] <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
    output_samples <- nrow(out)
    score_columns <- sum(!grepl("_CNT$", names(out)) & names(out) != "SAMPLE")
  }

  data.frame(
    engine = engine,
    runs = n,
    median_sec = stats::median(times),
    min_sec = min(times),
    max_sec = max(times),
    output_samples = output_samples,
    score_columns = score_columns,
    score_cells = output_samples * score_columns,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_duckdb_output <- function(vcf_path, summary_paths) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=1")
  on.exit(DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4"), add = TRUE)
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, duckdb_score_sql(vcf_path, summary_paths))
}

run_bcftools_once <- function(vcf_gz, summary_paths, output_path) {
  summary_args <- paste(shell_quote(summary_paths), collapse = " ")
  cmd <- sprintf(
    "BCFTOOLS_PLUGINS=%s %s +score --use GT -c PLINK --counts -o %s %s %s",
    shell_quote(score_plugin_dir),
    shell_quote(bcftools_bin),
    shell_quote(output_path),
    shell_quote(vcf_gz),
    summary_args
  )
  gc()
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  status <- system(cmd, ignore.stdout = TRUE, ignore.stderr = FALSE)
  elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) stop("bcftools +score failed", call. = FALSE)

  list(
    elapsed = elapsed,
    output = output_path,
    data = utils::read.delim(output_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  )
}

bcftools_score_text <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, sprintf("%#.6g", as.numeric(x)))
}

compare_outputs <- function(duck_out, bcf_out) {
  stopifnot(setequal(names(duck_out), names(bcf_out)),
            !anyDuplicated(duck_out$SAMPLE), !anyDuplicated(bcf_out$SAMPLE))
  common_cols <- names(duck_out)
  score_cols <- setdiff(common_cols, "SAMPLE")

  merged <- merge(duck_out[, common_cols, drop = FALSE],
                  bcf_out[, common_cols, drop = FALSE],
                  by = "SAMPLE", all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_duck", "_bcf"))

  n_match <- 0L
  n_mismatch <- 0L
  n_only_duck <- sum(is.na(match(duck_out$SAMPLE, bcf_out$SAMPLE)))
  n_only_bcf <- sum(is.na(match(bcf_out$SAMPLE, duck_out$SAMPLE)))
  max_abs_diff <- 0
  max_rel_diff <- 0

  for (col in score_cols) {
    duck_col <- paste0(col, "_duck")
    bcf_col <- paste0(col, "_bcf")
    if (duck_col %in% names(merged) && bcf_col %in% names(merged)) {
      if (grepl("_CNT$", col)) {
        d <- as.numeric(merged[[duck_col]])
        b <- as.numeric(merged[[bcf_col]])
        matches <- !is.na(d) & !is.na(b) & d == b
      } else {
        d_text <- bcftools_score_text(merged[[duck_col]])
        b_text <- bcftools_score_text(merged[[bcf_col]])
        d <- as.numeric(d_text)
        b <- as.numeric(b_text)
        matches <- !is.na(d_text) & !is.na(b_text) & d_text == b_text
      }
      abs_diff <- abs(d - b)
      denom <- pmax(abs(d), abs(b), 1.0)
      rel_diff <- abs_diff / denom
      n_match <- n_match + sum(matches, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_mismatch <- n_mismatch + sum(!matches, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_abs_diff <- max(c(max_abs_diff, abs_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
      max_rel_diff <- max(c(max_rel_diff, rel_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  data.frame(
    duck_samples = nrow(duck_out),
    bcf_samples = nrow(bcf_out),
    score_columns = sum(!grepl("_CNT$", score_cols)),
    count_columns = sum(grepl("_CNT$", score_cols)),
    compared_score_cells = nrow(duck_out) * sum(!grepl("_CNT$", score_cols)),
    compared_count_cells = nrow(duck_out) * sum(grepl("_CNT$", score_cols)),
    cell_matches = n_match,
    cell_mismatches = n_mismatch,
    only_duck_samples = n_only_duck,
    only_bcftools_samples = n_only_bcf,
    max_abs_diff_after_bcftools_text = max_abs_diff,
    max_rel_diff_after_bcftools_text = max_rel_diff,
    outputs_match = (n_mismatch == 0L && n_only_duck == 0L && n_only_bcf == 0L),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

compare_sql_output <- function(native, reference) {
  counts <- grep("_CNT$", names(native), value = TRUE)
  scores <- setdiff(names(native), c("SAMPLE", counts))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(names(reference)),
            setequal(names(reference), c(names(native), paste0(scores, "_BOUND"))),
            identical(native$SAMPLE, reference$SAMPLE))
  differences <- abs(as.matrix(native[scores]) - as.matrix(reference[scores]))
  bounds <- as.matrix(reference[paste0(scores, "_BOUND")])
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(differences)), all(is.finite(bounds)),
            all(differences <= bounds), !anyNA(native[counts]), !anyNA(reference[counts]),
            identical(as.matrix(native[counts]), as.matrix(reference[counts])))
  data.frame(score_cells = length(differences), count_cells = nrow(native) * length(counts),
             max_abs_difference = max(differences), max_bound = max(bounds),
             outputs_match = TRUE)
}

run_benchmark_case <- function(fixture, summary_paths, n = 3L) {
  duck_out <- run_duckdb_output(fixture$vcf_gz, summary_paths)
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=1")
  set_sql_inputs(fixture$vcf_gz, summary_paths, bounds = TRUE)
  sql_out <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, score_reference)
  sql_comparison <- compare_sql_output(duck_out, sql_out)
  parity_path <- tempfile("bcftools_score_parity_", fileext = ".tsv")
  on.exit(unlink(parity_path), add = TRUE)
  upstream <- run_bcftools_once(fixture$vcf_gz, summary_paths, parity_path)
  comparison <- compare_outputs(duck_out, upstream$data)
  if (!comparison$outputs_match) {
    print(comparison)
    print(merge(duck_out, upstream$data, by = "SAMPLE", suffixes = c("_native", "_upstream")))
    stop("Native/upstream score parity failed before timing")
  }

  duck <- run_duckdb_bench(fixture$vcf_gz, summary_paths, n = n)
  sql <- run_duckdb_bench(fixture$vcf_gz, summary_paths, n = n, engine = "duckhts_sql")

  bcftools_times <- numeric(n)
  bcftools_out <- NULL
  output_samples <- NA_integer_
  score_columns <- NA_integer_
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    out_tsv <- tempfile("bcftools_score_", fileext = ".tsv")
    run <- run_bcftools_once(fixture$vcf_gz, summary_paths, out_tsv)
    bcftools_times[i] <- run$elapsed
    output_samples <- nrow(run$data)
    score_columns <- sum(!grepl("_CNT$", names(run$data)) & names(run$data) != "SAMPLE")
    if (i == 1L) bcftools_out <- run$data
    unlink(out_tsv, force = TRUE)
  }

  bench <- rbind(
    duck,
    sql,
    data.frame(
      engine = "bcftools_RBCFTools",
      runs = n,
      median_sec = stats::median(bcftools_times),
      min_sec = min(bcftools_times),
      max_sec = max(bcftools_times),
      output_samples = output_samples,
      score_columns = score_columns,
      score_cells = output_samples * score_columns,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
  bench$variants <- fixture$n_variants
  bench$samples <- fixture$n_samples
  bench$genotype_cells <- fixture$n_variants * fixture$n_samples

  list(
    bench = bench[, c("engine", "runs", "median_sec", "min_sec", "max_sec",
                      "variants", "samples", "genotype_cells",
                      "output_samples", "score_columns", "score_cells")],
    compare = compare_outputs(duck_out, bcftools_out),
    sql_compare = sql_comparison
  )
}
```

```{r comparator-controls}
# Counts compare as integers, independently of R's numeric printing conventions.
control <- data.frame(SAMPLE = "S", prs = 1, prs_CNT = 500000)
integer_control <- transform(control, prs_CNT = 500000L)
stopifnot(compare_outputs(control, integer_control)$outputs_match)
stopifnot(!compare_outputs(control, transform(control, prs_CNT = 500001L))$outputs_match)
stopifnot(!compare_outputs(control, transform(control, prs = 2))$outputs_match)
stopifnot(!compare_outputs(control, transform(control, SAMPLE = "other"))$outputs_match)
```

## Synthetic Single-PRS Case

```{r synthetic-single, echo = FALSE}
set.seed(42L)
fixture_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "duckhts_score_benchmark")
fixture <- write_score_fixture(fixture_dir, n_variants = bench_rows,
                               n_samples = n_samples, n_prs = n_prs)
single_case <- run_benchmark_case(fixture, fixture$summary_paths[1], n = bench_runs)
single_case$bench
```

```{r synthetic-single-compare, echo = FALSE}
single_case$compare
single_case$sql_compare
```
